{{Quote|And the race is underway!|The announcer|<ref name="The Roon Games" />}}
An '''announcer''' that commentated on the [[Drainsweeper/Legends|Drainsweeper]] race during the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon's]] annual [[Roon Colonial Games]].<ref name="The Roon Games" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The announcer appeared in ''[[The Roon Games]]'', the eleventh episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', voiced by [[Rob Cowan]].<ref name="The Roon Games" />
